# ResQ Tyres & Recovery

> 24/7 mobile tyre fitting and puncture repair in Leeds and across West Yorkshire. We come to the
> vehicle — home, workplace or roadside — with brand-new tyres on board. There is no shop or depot
> to visit; the service is mobile only.

**What we do.** Mobile tyre replacement, with new tyres brought to you and fitted on site. Puncture
repair, where the tyre can be safely repaired — from £70, up to £120 depending on distance and tyre
size. 24-hour emergency tyre call-out, 365 days a year including bank holidays. Planned tyre fitting
at home or at work, at the same price as in-store. On-site wheel balancing and valve replacement.
Locking wheel-nut removal — we carry the specialist tools.

**What we do not do.** No wheel alignment. No fitting at a garage, shop or depot: there is no
premises to visit. No vehicle recovery — "Recovery" appears in the registered trading name only, and
the services offered are the ones listed above. Bradford (BD postcodes) is outside the coverage area.

**Coverage.** These confirmed postcode districts, and only these: all Leeds districts LS1 to LS29,
including LS24 (Tadcaster); HG1, HG2 and HG3 around Harrogate; and WF1, WF2, WF3, WF4, WF5, WF8,
WF10, WF12 and WF13 across Wakefield, Castleford, Pontefract and Dewsbury. Towns named on the site
are Leeds, Wakefield, Dewsbury, Pudsey, Morley, Castleford, Garforth, Pontefract, Harrogate and
Tadcaster. Outside those districts, call and ask — it may still be possible to reach you.

**Hours.** Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, including bank holidays.

**Prices and payment.** Fitted tyre prices vary by tyre size; the price guide on the site gives a
range, and the exact price is confirmed by phone before any work starts. Mobile fitting is included
in the price, not charged as an extra. 30% off when all four tyres are changed, subject to
availability. No deposit and no online payment — payment is on completion, by card or cash.

**Contact.** Phone 07438 562633 (+44 7438 562633). WhatsApp https://wa.me/447438562633. Email
resqtyresrecovery@gmail.com. Address: Unit 8A, Lavender Walk, Leeds, LS9 8TX, United Kingdom.

**About.** Trading name ResQ Tyres & Recovery. Operating since 2023, based in Leeds.

- [Services](https://www.resqtyres.co.uk/#services): mobile tyre fitting and puncture repair, and 24-hour emergency call-out.
- [Plan a home tyre fitting](https://www.resqtyres.co.uk/#enquiry): enquiry form for a booked fitting at home or work.
